entities.summary: Magnus (Mauno) Rosendal was a Finnish educator and politician, born in Hämeenkyrö. He was a member of the Diet of Finland from 1905 to 1906 and of the Parliament of Finland from 1908 to 1909, representing the Young Finnish Party.
